column1: # Constructed points scorecard (Lab 17.3). Income (thousand $/yr): >=60 -> 30 points, 40-59 -> 20, <40 -> 10. Debt ratio: <0.30 -> 30, 0.30-0.44 -> 15, >=0.45 -> 0. Months at job: >=24 -> 20, 12-23 -> 10, <12 -> 0. Late payments (24 months): 0 -> 20, 1 -> 10, 2+ -> 0. Bankruptcy on record before 2020: no -> 10, yes -> 0. Total >= 70 -> approve; otherwise refer to a person.
